Application Data.DESCRIPTION OF OPERATIONS: Radiant Glow Cosmetics specializes in the retail of high-quality skincare and beauty products, including serums, moisturizers, and makeup essentials. We prioritize customer safety and satisfaction by sourcing ingredients from reputable suppliers and conducting rigorous quality control checks. Our operations include both in-store sales and a secure e-commerce platform, allowing us to reach a broader customer base while ensuring compliance with all regulatory standards. We emphasize honest marketing practices and transparency regarding product ingredients, maintaining a commitment to responsible advertising. Additionally, we implement stringent inventory control measures and maintain comprehensive liability insurance to protect against potential product-related claims.
